clue.text: Get less following cut

indicators.note: less means minus, so the letter for following is subtracted from the word for get

parts.note: to get something is to fetch it
f. is the abbreviation for following, as in page references

explanation.surface: An instruction to take home less after a pay cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'less' takes F (following) out of FETCH, leaving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To etch is to engrave or incise a design, a kind of cutting into a surface.

clue.text: Wrongly suggest holding unfinished story back

indicators.note: holding means one word contains another inside it

parts.note: to suggest something is to imply it

indicators.note: back says the shortened story word is read from right to left
unfinished means the last letter of the story word is cut off

parts.note: a news story is a report

explanation.surface: Someone hints in the wrong way while keeping back part of a tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfinished' drops the last letter and 'back' reverses what remains, giving ROPER; 'holding' wraps the suggest word round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something improperly means doing it incorrectly or in the wrong manner, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Talk in country about weight and heart of dogma

indicators.note: about means the country word surrounds the weight letter

parts.note: China is a country

indicators.note: heart of picks out the central letter of the word dogma

explanation.surface: A discussion in some nation about the gravity and core of a creed.
explanation.definitionFit: A chinwag is informal British slang for a chat or gossip, so it means talk.

clue.text: Question bishop in part fed to head of government

indicators.note: fed to means the inner group of letters goes inside the government head's letters

parts.note: PM is the Prime Minister, head of the UK government

indicators.note: in places the bishop letter within the word for part

parts.note: an actor's part is a role
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A cleric is asked to take a part in briefing the Prime Minister.
explanation.definitionFit: A problem is a matter to be resolved, like a question set for solving.

clue.text: Piece of data that's given by saint and is in Greek dialect

indicators.note: in means the word is sits within the dialect word

parts.note: Attic is the dialect of ancient Athens
taken as written

explanation.surface: A fact supplied by a holy man, phrased in an ancient Greek tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: A statistic is a single numerical fact, a piece of data in a collection.

clue.text: Relative insider having odd characters banished by church

indicators.note: removing the odd-numbered letters of insider leaves only its even-placed ones

parts.note: CE stands for Church of England

explanation.surface: A family member with inside knowledge has eccentrics expelled by the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having odd characters banished' strips the 1st, 3rd, 5th and 7th letters of 'insider', leaving NIE.
explanation.definitionFit: A niece is a sibling's daughter, a family relation.

clue.text: Revolutionary crowd with energy and desire including expert novelist

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning round, so the crowd word is read backwards

parts.note: to crowd a space is to cram it
E is the physics symbol for energy

indicators.note: including means the desire word holds the expert word inside it

parts.note: lust is strong desire
a pro is an expert, a professional

explanation.surface: A rebellious mob with vigour and longing takes in a professional writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Marcel Proust was the French author of In Search of Lost Time, a celebrated novelist.

clue.text: Progress without obstruction from one disrupting schemes in a bad way

indicators.note: disrupting means the one-letter piece breaks into the schemes word

parts.note: schemes are plans
I is the Roman numeral for one
someone in a bad way is ailing, unwell

explanation.surface: Smooth progress comes from someone wrecking poor plans.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain sailing is an idiom for an easy course of action with no hindrances.

clue.text: Round left in quiz

indicators.note: in places the left letter inside the quiz word

parts.note: to quiz someone is to pump them for information

explanation.surface: A quiz round in which one contestant has been left behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Plump means rounded or chubby in shape, so it serves for the adjective round.

clue.text: Man reacts to change in holy ritual

indicators.note: to change means the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man responds to alterations in a religious ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: A sacrament is a Christian rite such as baptism or communion, a sacred ceremony.

clue.text: Arbiter drops recurring phrase

parts.note: an arbiter in sport is a referee, ref for short
rain falls as drops

explanation.surface: A referee lets the ball fall from his hands.
explanation.definitionFit: A refrain is a repeated line or chorus in a song or poem.

clue.text: Exhibit posted in advance?

definitions.meaning: to exhibit something is to show or display it
a whimsical reading as ..., sent beforehand

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the punning second sense: split into a prefix meaning before and a word meaning posted.
explanation.definitionFit: To present is to show or display, and the split form means mailed beforehand.

clue.text: Reverse taxes in wrong area, doing volte-face

indicators.note: in means the taxes word sits inside the turned-round letters
a volte-face is an about-turn, so wrong and area are read backwards

parts.note: a sin is a wrong
tithes were taxes of a tenth paid to the church

explanation.surface: A government reverses course on taxes after misjudging a region.
explanation.walkthrough: One indicator, 'doing volte-face', turns both wrong and area together to make ANIS, which 'in' then opens up for the taxes.
explanation.definitionFit: An antithesis is the direct opposite of something, its reverse.

clue.text: Slight difficulties luring bears

indicators.note: bears means carries, so the two words carry the answer within them

explanation.surface: A minor problem attracts large animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A slur is an insult or slight against someone's reputation.

clue.text: Dance about before exercise ending in swim in river

indicators.note: in means the group of letters is placed inside the river's name

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, south-west England

indicators.note: before tells us the about letter comes ahead of the exercise word

parts.note: c. (circa) is an abbreviation for about
to exercise a right is to use it

indicators.note: ending in picks the final letter of swim

explanation.surface: A dancer goes about some exercise, finishing with a swim in the river.
explanation.definitionFit: An excuse-me is a ballroom dance in which partners may be changed by cutting in.

clue.text: Courtesy in competition, top Republican giving way to companion

indicators.note: giving way to means one piece is replaced by another

parts.note: rivalry is competition
R is the abbreviation for Republican, here at the top of the word
CH is Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: Good manners in a contest as a leading politician steps aside for a friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'giving way to' swaps the first R of RIVALRY for CH.
explanation.definitionFit: Chivalry is gallant, polite behaviour, the knightly ideal of courtesy.

clue.text: Force small contribution from speaker

indicators.note: from speaker means the word is as heard spoken, not as written

parts.note: the widow's mite is a small contribution

explanation.surface: Coercion obtained a modest donation from the person at the lectern.
explanation.definitionFit: Might is power or strength, which is what force means.

clue.text: Grasping devout, absorbing account supporting sun god

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means the later part sits below the sun god

parts.note: Ra was the Egyptian sun god

indicators.note: absorbing means the devout word takes the account letters inside

parts.note: devout means pious

explanation.surface: A greedy worshipper takes in a ledger while backing an Egyptian deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapacious means greedy and acquisitive, which is a sense of grasping.

clue.text: Tips on race got distributed in forecast

indicators.note: distributed means the letters are spread about into a new order

explanation.surface: Racing tips have been handed out in the form of a prediction.
explanation.definitionFit: To prognosticate is to predict the future, the verb forecast.

clue.text: Referring to fiction with frequency for assistance

parts.note: re means about or referring to
a lie is a fiction

explanation.surface: A request for help citing a novel and how often it happens.
explanation.definitionFit: Relief is help given to those in need, so it serves as assistance.

clue.text: Wail, wanting vegetable? Then deserve to go without it

parts.note: a yam is a starchy tuber vegetable

indicators.note: to go without means the word it is dropped from the deserve word

parts.note: to deserve is to merit
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone complains about lacking vegetables, then claims to merit going without.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to go without' takes IT out of MERIT, leaving MER.
explanation.definitionFit: To yammer is to whine or complain noisily, close to wail.

clue.text: Although receiving support, hard to wear long unwanted item

indicators.note: receiving means the word for although takes the support word inside

parts.note: while can mean although
a tee is the support for a golf ball

indicators.note: to wear means the long word holds the hard letter, as clothing holds a wearer

parts.note: to long is to pant for something
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Despite having help, a long garment is hard to wear and nobody wants it.
explanation.definitionFit: A white elephant is a burdensome possession nobody wants, from the costly sacred beasts of Siam.

clue.text: Event with obstacles raised up and in cases wrecked

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the word up is read bottom to top
wrecked means the letters of the two words are scrambled

explanation.surface: A show-jumping competition sees cases lifted and smashed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns UP into PU; 'wrecked' makes ISSANCE from IN CASES.
explanation.definitionFit: Puissance is a show-jumping event over a very high wall, a contest with obstacles.

clue.text: Not fanciful to follow team of stars

indicators.note: to follow puts the not-fanciful word after the team word

parts.note: a team is a side
not fanciful means real

explanation.surface: A down-to-earth supporter follows a team of star players.
explanation.definitionFit: Sidereal means relating to the stars, as in sidereal time.

clue.text: Subversive ace turning up with no name

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for ace in cards

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the shortened word is read bottom to top
with no means the name letter is removed

parts.note: turning means rotating

explanation.surface: A rebel ace changes sides without being named.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no' takes N out of ROTATING, and 'up' turns ROTATIG into GITATOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An agitator stirs up rebellion, a subversive person.

clue.text: Dispute article about time in ancient city

indicators.note: about means the pieces go round the time letter

parts.note: to spar is to argue or dispute
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An argument over an item about history in a classical town.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparta was a powerful city-state of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Meal for pound

definitions.meaning: a self-service spread of food laid out on a table
to batter or strike repeatedly, as waves do

explanation.definitionFit: A buffet is a meal people serve themselves, and to buffet is to strike repeatedly.

clue.text: Island covering inner part of grid

parts.note: a cap is a covering for the head or a bottle

indicators.note: inner part of picks the middle letters of the word grid

explanation.surface: A lid covering the centre of a grill on an isle.
explanation.definitionFit: Capri is an Italian island in the Bay of Naples.
